data.name: Areeba
data.gender_notes: Areeba is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root أ-ر-ب (ʾ-r-b), 'to be skilful, wise'. Arība means 'wise'. Its root is أ-ر-ب (ʾ-r-b). A common Muslim female name. Areeba is a Arabic name meaning “Wise; intelligent; brilliant”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Areeba expresses “Wise; intelligent; brilliant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root أ-ر-ب (ʾ-r-b), 'to be skilful, wise'. Arība means 'wise'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Areeba total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
